profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin Aerospace

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Software designed and development engineer in C++

positions.title: Embedded Software Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Developed F-22 ESMS OFP (Enhanced Store Management Set, Operational Flight Program) Real Time Embedded Software using Rhapsody C++.
Software development for the F-22 AMRAAM (AIM-120).
Developed test using C++ for the F-22 ESMS Software Test 
UML design. Object-oriented programming in C++.

positions.title: Embedded Software Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Performed F-35 Software Integration in C++.
Performed OFP (Operational Flight Program) Build and Checkout in C++. Debug build software, data analysis using ADA Multi Debugger.

positions.title: Embedded Software Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the Fire Control OFP design, code, integration of the T-50 (Korean F-16) program using the C programming language.
Implement Fire Control OFP code to resolve SPARS and to reflect RWP changes.
Assist T-50 test station software group in the area of design, simulation, GUIs.
Real Time Embedded Software Development for MMC program using ADA.
Assist MMC and JSF F-35 software groups in reviewing code and doing SPEs.
Assist F-22 CNI, and F-22 AVS software groups.

positions.title: Senior System Engineer
positions.description:
Performed avionics system integration, signal interface verification, data analysis, problem isolation, and hardware, software test and evaluation.
Designed test plans, procedures for functional testing of avionics system.
Worked on various programs: Block 50 US Air Force, Block 50 Special Projects, and FMS programs: KFP, Peace Carvin, and Peace Xenia.
Supported flight tests at Edward Air Force Base: monitor test flights, data analysis, and perform aircraft ground test. TOs (Technical Orders)
Wrote Aerospace Equipment Instructions (AEIs) for F-16 (USAF and FMS) aircraft ground test.
Support F-16 Flight Lines to checkout F-16 Avionics at LM Fort Worth.
Familiar with MIL-STD-1553B/194 MUX Interfaces.
